title: Discovering like a scientist: Literature-informed dimensionless learning for physical closure of data-driven equations
abstract: arXiv:2611.05780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven methods can recover compact equations, yet the physical dependence of their coefficients across operating conditions often remains unresolved. Dimensionless groups can explain this variation, but selecting relevant groups from the many dimensionally admissible combinations remains challenging. Here, we introduce a knowledge-guided framework for dimensionless learning, called {\pi}-former. It learns patterns of variable association and exponent assignment from a corpus of 1,288 established dimensionless groups. Under exact dimensional constraints, the model proposes interpretable basic groups whose combinations are optimized against observations. Across seven physical problems, the framework identifies predictive dimensionless coordinates within seconds. Integration with equation discovery further expresses condition-dependent coefficients through these coordinates, recovering established physical scalings in multi-condition

translated_title: 像科学家一样发现：基于文献信息的无量纲学习实现数据驱动方程的物理闭合
translated_abstract: 数据驱动方法能够恢复出紧凑的方程，但其系数在不同工况下的物理依赖关系往往仍未得到解决。无量纲群可以解释这种变化，但从众多量纲上可行的组合中筛选出相关的无量纲群仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种知识引导的无量纲学习框架，称为 π-former。该模型从包含 1,288 个已确立无量纲群的语料库中学习变量关联和指数分配的模式。在严格的量纲约束下，模型提出可解释的基本无量纲群，并通过观测数据对其组合进行优化。在七个物理问题中，该框架能在几秒钟内识别出具有预测能力的无量纲坐标。与方程发现方法集成后，可进一步通过这些坐标表达依赖于工况的系数，从而在多工况场景下恢复出已被确立的物理标度关系。
tldr: 本文提出知识引导的无量纲学习框架 π-former，通过从 1,288 个已确立无量纲群中学习变量关联与指数分配模式，能在几秒内识别出预测性无量纲坐标，从而解释数据驱动方程系数随工况的变化并恢复既有的物理标度关系。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces π-former, a knowledge-guided dimensionless learning framework that learns variable association and exponent assignment patterns from 1,288 established dimensionless groups, identifying predictive dimensionless coordinates within seconds to physically close data-driven equations and recover established multi-condition physical scalings.
